content:
{
  "root_cause": "The datepicker does not hide when the input loses focus via Tab navigation, causing the calendar to remain visible after focus moves to another field.",
  "repair_strategy": "Add a blur event listener to the date input field that calls datepicker.hide() to close the calendar when the input loses focus.",
  "edits": [
    {
      "path": "js/Datepicker.js",
      "sha256": "55bc634a806da095ca30921bdc0d463fdc2fd63dff3eeab32b3d673bab3ef609",
      "before": "      // set up event listeners in other modes
      const onMousedownDocument = onClickOutside.bind(null, this);
      const listeners = [
        [inputField, 'keydown', onKeydown.bind(null, this)],
        [inputField, 'focus', onFocus.bind(null, this)],
        [inputField, 'mousedown', onMousedown.bind(null, this)],
        [inputField, 'click', onClickInput.bind(null, this)],
        [inputField, 'paste', onPaste.bind(null, this)],
        [document, 'mousedown', onMousedownDocument],
        [document, 'touchstart', onMousedownDocument],
        [window, 'resize', picker.place.bind(picker)]
      ];
      registerListeners(this, listeners);",
      "after": "      // set up event listeners in other modes
      const onMousedownDocument = onClickOutside.bind(null, this);
      const listeners = [
        [inputField, 'keydown', onKeydown.bind(null, this)],
        [inputField, 'focus', onFocus.bind(null, this)],
        [inputField, 'blur', () => this.hide()],
        [inputField, 'mousedown', onMousedown.bind(null, this)],
        [inputField, 'click', onClickInput.bind(null, this)],
        [inputField, 'paste', onPaste.bind(null, this)],
        [document, 'mousedown', onMousedownDocument],
        [document, 'touchstart', onMousedownDocument],
        [window, 'resize', picker.place.bind(picker)]
      ];
      registerListeners(this, listeners);"
    }
  ],
  "expected_accessibility_effect": "Keyboard users can navigate away from the date field without leaving the date picker open, ensuring predictable focus management and visibility of UI components, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) and 2.4.3 (Focus Order).",
  "functional_risks": [
    "Potential premature closure if blur fires unexpectedly (e.g., when a popup steals focus), but the datepicker already handles external clicks via document mousedown listeners.",
    "If the datepicker programmatically shifts focus without blurring, it could hide prematurely; however, typical usage does not involve such patterns."
  ],
  "verification_requirements": [
    "After typing a date and pressing Tab, the date picker (.datepicker) must be invisible.",
    "Selecting a date via mouse or keyboard should still update the input field and respect autohide behavior.",
    "Inline datepickers (if any) must remain unaffected by the change.",
    "Clicking outside the picker should continue to close it as before."
  ]
}
